history_episodes.summary: The expiry contract is is_expired(expires_at, now) over ISO timestamps: convert aware offsets to UTC, interpret a naive timestamp as UTC, preserve fractional seconds, and expire inclusively when now equals expires_at. Do not strip or overwrite an existing offset.
